systems.country_label: Plataforma SIGE 2.0 (Sistema de Informação e Gestão Escolar)
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education (DGEPASE), supported by the NGO FEC's PESIDE project
systems.tiers: Stated in the 2025 report as operational and available to the whole network of sectoral and regional statisticians and at DGEPASE; 92 regional and sectoral statisticians and education inspectors trained to use it; 328 school heads and deputy heads trained in collecting education data

note: No fact: SIGE 2.0 is described as a platform for education statistics used by sectoral and regional statisticians and DGEPASE, with school heads trained to collect data; the report describes no entry by schools of per-learner records, so the system is a census.
